## Historical software protection contract — 2026-11-12 (SUPERSEDED 2026-11-14)

The 2026-11-12 statement that OVP/OCP were fully retired from software is
historical and was superseded by the user's explicit 2026-11-14 decision.
Current contract: preserve OVP/OCP telemetry entities, register 82/83 readbacks,
protection diagnostics and existing managed software trip handling. Raw R16
1/2 are OVP/OCP trips respectively; R16=3 is OPP. Do not program OVP/OCP
thresholds from software; the current physical adapter exposes V/I setters only.
Raw R16 / OVP / OCP / OPP decoding remains inside Telemetry/Safety/diagnostics.
MAIN Guard, charge programs, application/session business logic and UI consume
only normalized ProtectionVerdict/projection and must not inspect raw codes or
protection names. HANDS_OFF/AUTONOMOUS remains read-only for bot-originated
actuation. Physical protection thresholds must never be disabled or rewritten,
including zero writes. See AGENTS.md § OVP/OCP protection visibility and
managed handling (2026-11-14) and the later protection-boundary entries below.

## Wake observer Telegram network error isolation — 2026-11-11

`aiogram.dispatcher` polling network timeout is an external transport error,
not `charger.fault` and never critical. Brief failures and recovery are silent.
Continuous polling outage of at least 300 seconds emits one
`charger.telegram_unavailable` warning; recovery after warning sends
`charger.telegram_recovered` info. Watchdog, MAIN Guard and hardware faults
remain immediate. The observer is deployed independently, without restarting
the charging bot; temporary installer files must be removed after verification.

## Wake observer START event contract — 2026-11-11

When `program_active` transitions from false to true, suppress the pending
routine heartbeat until a post-START, timestamped Output=ON readback and fresh
voltage/current telemetry are available. Send one `charger.start_confirmed`
with measured U/I/temperature/stage/Guard/Output; do not report the stale
pre-ON snapshot as a successful START. If no confirmation within 120 seconds,
send one warning `charger.start_output_unconfirmed`; likewise on early abort.
Persist transition state in observer outbox; do not replay a false START report
when observer restarts mid-session. Fault and service alerts bypass this delay.
Only restart the observer for this rule; never restart an active charge bot.
Remove temporary deployment files after verified activation.

## ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО: актуальные физические данные — напрямую с ESP Native API

**БРАТЬ АКТУАЛЬНЫЕ ДАННЫЕ С ESP, А НЕ ИЗ HA, СТАРОГО ОТЧЁТА ИЛИ КЭША.**
На node104 авторитетный физический источник — непосредственно ESPHome Native API
контроллера ESP (текущий адрес стенда `192.168.1.28:6053`), через уже
существующий `esp_direct` / `aioesphomeapi` клиент и свежую подписку на
`SensorState` / `BinarySensorState`. Это первый шаг **каждой** проверки
Output, START, STOP, lease, аварии, деплоя и физической приёмки.
Доступность TCP-порта сама по себе **не является** физическим readback.

Каждый раз заново читать с ESP: физический Output **R18**, измеренные U/I,
напряжение АКБ, уставки Vset/Iset, OVP/OCP и защиту R16, lease
armed/generation/remaining/Modbus age, trip/quarantine/autonomous. Проверять
идентичность ESP, типы полей, источник `esp_native_api`, временные метки
подписки и фактическую свежесть; для post-STOP доказательства применять
имеющийся строгий post-command критерий свежего R18 и нулевых U/I.

HA102 — **вторичный путь к тому же ESP**, полезный для независимой сверки,
но не заменяющий прямые ESP Native callbacks. Прямой readback содержит R18,
измеренные U/I, Vset/Iset, raw R16 (отдельно OPP), lease и остальные
разрешённые физические сигналы. Программные проверки и сборщики не читают
OVP/OCP. Старые снимки, журналы, показания Telegram UI и HA-кэш описывают
только историю. Не заявлять `Output OFF` или `PHYSICAL PASS` по ним.

При отсутствии доступа к Native API сначала найти **уже установленный**
ESP direct-клиент и штатный read-only collector, разобраться с доступом.
Если чтение действительно невозможно, написать **ESP ACCESS BLOCKED**,
а не «физическое состояние неизвестно, потому что HA не свежий». Не
симулировать значения, не обходить запреты инструментов и не отправлять
непосредственные ESP-кнопки/Modbus-команды вне единственного ExecutionPort.

## 1. Назначение проекта

Проект — не просто контроллер RD6018. Он разделяет операторский интерфейс,
домен зарядки, доказательную телеметрию, диагностику, безопасность и физическое
исполнение:

```text
человек
  |
  v
bot/UI adapter
  |
  v
V3 Runtime
  +-- telemetry evidence
  +-- diagnostics and bank-fault evidence
  +-- charge strategy
  +-- safety and execution policy
  +-- journal/UI model/replay
  |
  v
physical hardware
```

## 2. Главный принцип

Бот — адаптер к оператору («кожаному мешку»). Он принимает намерения, показывает
состояние и передаёт запросы. Бот не владеет зарядом, RD6018 или деталями
оборудования. Любое физическое действие проходит через domain decision, safety,
execution policy, manual gate/lease и readback.

## 3. Текущая архитектура V3

Основные слои:

- Config Layer — параметры и секреты вне кода;
- Telemetry Evidence — snapshots, качество полей, история и аккумулятор Ah;
- Diagnostics — состояние АКБ, bank-fault evidence и diagnostic authority;
- Charge Domain — BatteryProfile, recipe, MAIN/RECOVERY/MIX strategy и intents;
- Safety Evidence/Engine — агрегирует доказательства и fail-closed решения;
- Execution Policy — проверяет prerequisites перед передачей intent;
- Output/Physical Layer — SafeOutputIntent, gate, lease, bridge и readback;
- Journal/UI Model — события и read-only представление;
- Replay/Trace — воспроизводимость решений без железа.

## 4. Charge domain

Единый владелец решений — runtime charge strategy, не bot. Основной путь:

```text
MAIN -> plateau/recovery -> MAIN или MIX -> hold -> SAFE_WAIT/DONE
```

В MIX разделены физические варианты:

- CC: Vmax подтверждается, затем наблюдается подтверждённое падение напряжения
  по ΔV;
- CV: Imin подтверждается, затем наблюдается подтверждённый рост тока по ΔI;
- подтверждённый delta запускает sticky hold;
- current containment в CV MIX стартует через 30 минут и пересчитывается каждые
  10 минут только вниз;
- аномалия внешней температуры или bank fault передаются как safety evidence и
  могут заблокировать заряд.

Числа, времена, лимиты и запасы задаются конфигурацией/recipe, а не
монолитной логикой.

## 5. Battery diagnostics

Решение о продолжении HV-заряда опирается на telemetry quality, battery
diagnostics, bank-fault evidence, temperature integrity и safety evidence.
Если доказан отказ банки с достаточной уверенностью, результатом является
запрет/остановка через SafetyEngine; диагностика сама не пишет в RD.

## 6. Physical architecture

Два независимых коннектора к одному RD6018:

```text
V3 PhysicalBridge Contract
          |
    +-----+------+
    v            v
HAESPConnector  ESPDirectConnector
    |            |
    v            v
  HA 102       ESP 128
      \        /
        RD6018
```

HA и ESP-direct — альтернативные независимые пути, не последовательные звенья
и не автоматический fallback. Текущая конфигурация и порядок доступа описаны в
`config/physical/connectors.yaml`, `ha102.yaml`, `esp128.yaml` и
`docs/V3_BENCH_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.md`.

## 8. Physical execution status

Готово:

- config, capability discovery и два транспорта;
- snapshots/readback и manual gate/lease;
- battery-aware bench selection;
- короткий физический HA-ESP-RD переход с независимым ESP readback:
  `ON` подтверждён за `1.526 с`, `OFF` за `2.546 с`, нулевой ток — отдельным
  readback примерно через `5 с`;
- evidence и ожидание задержанного readback в executor.

Не сделано:

- полноценный заряд через V3;
- production wiring и автоматическое управление;
- независимый полный `OFF -> ON -> OFF` run через ESP-direct;
- замена V2/V1 UI. V1 UI сохраняется отдельно и является источником
  информационных требований.

При физическом тесте всегда: сначала battery voltage, затем Vset из config,
затем V/I/OVP/OCP readback, manual ARM, короткий ON hold, OFF и ожидание
`Output OFF + current 0 A`.

Операторский STOP ручной сессии выполняется через managed-stop workflow с
verified Output OFF. Устаревший callback `power_toggle` после установки этого
workflow не выполняет общий toggle и предлагает обновить панель.

## 9. Configuration model

```text
config/
  physical/   # transports, connectors, bench profile
  charge/     # recipes and limits
  safety/     # safety ceilings
  runtime/    # tolerances, polling and execution timing
  secrets     # only environment/secret references, never values in git
```

Все изменяемые параметры находятся в config и сопровождаются RU/EN
комментариями. Секреты читаются через environment references.

## 10. Journal/UI

UI — read-only consumer ViewModel. Первая строка активной панели имеет вид
`RD6018 · ЗАРЯД · <регулятор>` слева и `MAIN`/`MIX`/`FLOAT` справа; АКБ
показывается отдельной строкой. Он показывает stage/phase, параметры,
таймеры, transition evidence, diagnostics, safety, output и хвост журнала.
Журнал имеет однострочные пользовательские записи и отдельные event records;
форматирование не находится в charge engine. Production UI постепенно
нормализуется на declarative screen/button/action contracts; удалённые V1/V2
compatibility-фасады не являются допустимым fallback.

## 11. Operator Application Interface

Текущий production read path:

```text
Telegram adapter -> OperatorInterface -> OperatorSnapshot -> declarative renderer
```

`OperatorSnapshot` и `PanelLayout` содержат только данные и декларативные действия.
Они не содержат HA/RD/controller объектов. `application/operator_snapshot_provider.py`
читает explicit `OperatorReadSource`, diagnostics и journal, но не вызывает
start/stop или actuator methods. Старый shadow comparator и V1 UI compatibility
wrapper удалены после отсутствия production callers.

## 12. Следующие шаги

1. Продолжить удаление test/shadow-only migration islands, не достижимых от `bot.py`.
2. Переименовать или поглотить production-reachable `v2_*` модули только после
   миграции их callers и parity/full-suite доказательства.
3. Свести UI/runtime composition к нейтральным модульным именам без compatibility facades.
4. На каждом boundary обновлять `docs/README.md`, runbook и eradication ledger.
5. Production node 104 и физический заряд остаются отдельным operational boundary.

## 13. Запрещённые направления

- bot direct hardware control;
- параллельные несогласованные FSM;
- обход SafetyEngine, ExecutionPolicy, lease или verified readback;
- hardcoded voltage/current/time/limits;
- synthetic authorization или автоматический fallback между коннекторами;
- изменение ESPHome/firmware/node 104 без отдельного разрешения.


## 14. 2026-10-04 — Modular V3 and legacy eradication

Repository authority at the start of this migration:

- canonical remote branch: `main`;
- baseline: `6eb6980d1e4a4aeeb804ae25a59af8e292a3d324`;
- deployed VM104 remains on `c1298ea2df67bba1e4888de6e830b002b5db2fce`;
- deployment/restart/hardware mutation is outside this migration unless separately approved.

### 14.1 Decision

The transitional model where V3 wraps V1/V2 is no longer an acceptable target.
The migration must end with a genuinely modular production V3. Historical code
can be a bounded oracle during parity work, but a migrated capability must not
delegate its ownership back into the monolith.

Authoritative contracts:

- `docs/V3_MODULAR_ARCHITECTURE.md`;
- `docs/V3_UI_MODULAR_ARCHITECTURE.md`;
- `docs/V3_LEGACY_ERADICATION_LEDGER.md`.

### 14.2 Mandatory module boundaries

Production V3 is decomposed into:

1. composition/lifecycle;
2. application intents/use cases;
3. charge programs/stages;
4. signal/evidence;
5. safety concerns;
6. execution transaction;
7. telemetry;
8. ownership/session;
9. persistence;
10. infrastructure adapters;
11. UI/presentation/Telegram transport.

No module may recover a removed dependency by monkey-patching the historical
runtime.

### 14.3 Configuration rule

Every configurable number, duration, threshold, enum or policy value has one
semantic owner and one declaration location in that owner's `variables.py` or
`config.py`.

Every declaration documents:

- key and type;
- unit;
- description;
- owner;
- default;
- range/allowed values;
- provenance;
- override policy;
- change effect (runtime/restart/deploy).

Consumers receive typed configuration. Copying the literal into another module
is prohibited.

### 14.4 UI is a first-class migration workstream

UI parity is not left until the end. Screens, buttons, navigation, components,
graphs and future operator actions are modular.

A new V3 button is a `ButtonSpec` with a stable `UIAction`; it does not contain
a hardware callback. Telegram callback data is a transport concern, not the
application API.

A future screen/button must not require editing `runtime/v2_runtime.py`,
`charge_logic.py`, controller classes, safety or execution modules.

### 14.5 Legacy eradication sequence

#### ERADICATION-01 — prevent legacy resurrection

- retire environment-controlled legacy decision authority;
- hard-deny START when the production START route is absent;
- remove the hidden direct V/I/OVP/OCP/Output START fallback;
- disable direct `bot_legacy.py` execution;
- add architecture/static regression contracts;
- establish module variable metadata and declarative UI primitives.

Gate: no software behavior or hardware values change in the canonical
production route; tests prove removed fallback cannot return.

#### ERADICATION-02 — extract MAIN

- characterize accepted MAIN semantics;
- extract MAIN state/clock/tail/recovery decisions into modular charge code;
- reuse explicit safety/evidence services, not `super().tick()`;
- remove MAIN blanking/time masking of the historical FSM.

Gate: golden traces, restart and failure paths match accepted behavior and the
production MAIN path has no historical FSM transition call.

#### ERADICATION-02a — MAIN decision/config extraction (implemented; exact-head CI PASS)

- canonical MAIN decision owner: `runtime/charge/strategy/main_authority.py`;
- canonical MAIN variables: `runtime/charge/strategy/main_variables.py`;
- canonical base target selection: `runtime/charge/strategy/main_targets.py`;
- canonical stage-current ceiling declaration: `runtime/safety/variables.py`;
- compatibility `charge_authority.py` re-exports the new MAIN owner;
- transitional production controllers consume these modular owners;
- accepted 72h / 2h / 3h / 3/4 recovery budgets / AGM 14.4→15.0V semantics are regression-tested.
- first-stage tail/plateau/thermal/sag evidence moved to `runtime/charge/evidence/first_stage.py`;
- evidence thresholds live in `runtime/charge/evidence/first_stage_variables.py` with metadata;
- root `first_stage_evidence.py` reduced to a compatibility re-export.

ERADICATION-02 MAIN cutover is implemented: authoritative MAIN uses
`runtime/charge/runtime/main_scaffold.py` for accepted common runtime mechanics
and does not enter historical `ChargeController.tick()`. The MAIN blanking mask
and stage-clock falsification are removed. Handoff exact-head CI run `#1510`
(`37141127400`) passed on Python 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12 at
`396b364b79816366380ee89d452256d1e0bacf08`.

#### ERADICATION-03 — recovery lifecycle

- DESULFATION;
- recovery SAFE_WAIT;
- verified return to MAIN;
- continuation persistence and restart.

Gate: the complete `MAIN -> DESULFATION -> SAFE_WAIT -> MAIN` path is modular
and the old transition path is unreachable.

#### ERADICATION-04 — MIX and final Storage

- CV Imin/Delta-I;
- CC Vmax/Delta-V;
- confirmation spacing;
- sticky active-time hold;
- MIX limit;
- final SAFE_WAIT;
- verified Storage/DONE commit.

Gate: one evidence owner and one FSM path; no legacy Mix timer/Delta branch.

#### ERADICATION-05 — Manual/Custom

Manual is a separate program family sharing safety/execution only. It is not a
special-case escape hatch inside AUTO.

#### ERADICATION-06 — safety and execution convergence

Move all remaining setters/output calls behind the single execution owner.
Safety is split into concern modules and emits typed decisions.

Gate: static production scan finds no direct physical writes outside the
approved physical implementation.

#### ERADICATION-07 — UI cutover

Migrate screens one at a time to canonical ViewModels, `ScreenSpec`,
`ButtonSpec`, `UIAction` and application intents. Remove each old callback
after parity.

Gate: canonical UI imports no historical runtime/controller/HA/ESP modules.

#### ERADICATION-08 — runtime/composition cutover

Replace `_legacy`, `sys.modules` aliasing and top-level installer mutation
with one explicit composition object and lifecycle.

#### ERADICATION-09 — remove historical production graph

When all prior gates pass:

- no `runtime.v2_runtime` production import;
- no historical FSM production import;
- no `bot_legacy` production execution;
- remove remaining compatibility files only after archive/reference capture.

### 14.6 Per-boundary workflow

Every migration increment follows:

```text
characterize
-> modular implementation
-> parity tests
-> restart/failure tests
-> switch one route
-> prove new owner
-> remove old route
-> static no-regression guard
-> exact-head CI
```

Do not keep a fallback mutating path after a successful cutover.

### 14.7 Stop conditions

Stop before mutation/cutover if:

- ownership is ambiguous;
- a safety semantic would change without explicit decision;
- a configuration value has conflicting provenance;
- a second execution owner appears;
- UI needs direct hardware/controller access;
- restart could authorize Output ON from persisted state alone;
- parity evidence is missing.

- production VM104 was not touched.

Functional recovery cutover commit:

`0f161a85a847d010ea6b7b860c065295145adf7a` — Migrate recovery chain to modular V3 authority

Canonical recovery owners:

- `runtime/charge/strategy/desulfation.py`;
- `runtime/charge/strategy/desulfation_variables.py`;
- `runtime/charge/strategy/recovery_safe_wait.py`;
- `runtime/charge/strategy/safe_wait_variables.py`;
- `runtime/charge/runtime/recovery_scaffold.py`.

The authoritative recovery chain is now:

`MAIN -> DESULFATION -> recovery SAFE_WAIT -> verified MAIN`.

For this chain, historical `ChargeController.tick()` is no longer the
execution/decision scaffold. Static regression tests patch the historical tick
to fail if either authoritative DESULFATION or recovery SAFE_WAIT reaches it.

DESULFATION owns its duration, base voltage, 0.02C current rule, minimum target
current and stage-specific OCP margin through module-local `VariableSpec`
declarations. SAFE_WAIT owns the relaxation margin and bounded timeout.

Recovery SAFE_WAIT continuation now persists and validates:

- exact source and next stage;
- target V/I;
- start time;
- session identity;
- session generation;
- recovery attempt;
- AGM stage index.

Persisted continuation state is not sufficient to enable Output. A fresh
physical Output OFF observation is required before the strategy may request a
re-enable transaction. The software stage remains SAFE_WAIT while the request
is pending. The existing execution transaction still owns the physical
program/readback/enable/readback sequence, and only its successful verified
acknowledgement may commit SAFE_WAIT -> MAIN.

When the active session has a durable MAIN Current Guard, that same return
transaction first requires fresh direct ESP Native Output=OFF, Iset and clear
R16 protection evidence, issues the existing verified-OFF operation, and
requires newer OFF callbacks before programming. It restores the Guard's
original bounded MAIN current (never above the accepted recipe or global
stage limit), verifies fresh Iset, atomically saves the new Guard segment with
the charge session, and only then enables Output. Numeric OCP is not a MAIN
Guard admission gate or setter; its original physical protection owner remains
unchanged. The new MAIN segment starts with zero accrued time and a fresh
30-minute Guard interval. If preflight reports Output ON, no V/I/OCP target
is issued. This is software behavior; it does not constitute node104 or
hardware validation.

A restart defect was found while adding the required regression: historical
restore reconstructed DESULFATION `stage_start_time` from Ah and could corrupt
the bounded two-hour active-stage budget. The migrated controller now restores
the exact persisted DESULFATION stage clock after the legacy compatibility
restore. Recovery attempt and AGM step also survive restart.

## Non-negotiable modularity and configuration canon (2026-11-07)

**No new monoliths.** This applies to all RD6018 changes, including operator HMI, charging algorithms, recovery, telemetry, logging, and release tooling. An existing oversized file is not a license to add another feature branch to it.

- One module owns each capability, state transition, clock, renderer, configuration value, and side effect. Separate read models, pure policy/formatting, orchestration, Telegram adapter, hardware execution, and persistence. Composition wires them; it must not reimplement their rules.
- Every user-tunable duration, threshold, limit, recipe parameter, choice, and policy belongs in the owning module's declared typed `variables.py` / `config.py` (or the canonical existing recipe/spec registry). Define units, default, range, provenance, override policy, and change effect. All consumers read that same definition; no scattered literals, shadow settings, duplicate copies, or hidden environment overrides.
- Presentational countdowns **derive** from the existing SignalAnalyzer/MAIN authority timestamps and configured hold duration. They never establish their own timer, storage, charge transition authority, or additional polling process. Different chemistry/intent must not be inferred from ad-hoc UI constants.

**Operator evidence:** Telegram screenshot around 11:13 user local / 01:13 UTC on 2026-11-09, EFB 60 Ah recovery START rejected, Telegram displayed `output enable command returned false`. ## 2026-11-09 — D152 follow-up: is OVP/OCP=0 a supported disable command?

Owner correctly challenged the D151 fix: should determine whether protections can be **disabled at the start**, avoiding conflicts during MAIN→MIX, before relying on per-phase targets.

**Source-confirmed root cause of the 2026-11-09 01:13:04 UTC failure** is upstream of the physical RD6018: `runtime/safety/runtime_guard.py::set_ovp` and `set_ocp` explicitly reject `requested <= 0`. The installed `hass_api.py::_retire_unrequested_protection_limits` sends `set_ovp(0.0)` and `set_ocp(0.0)`; hence the wrapper returns `False` and logs `cannot retire old ovp=16.60`. **The refusal does not prove** that ESPHome/Modbus or the Riden hardware firmware refuses zero. The prior D151 note's phrase 'physical edge may reject it' was a hypothesis; this guard rejection is established by exact code. The source-only D151 repair avoids zero by writing bounded protection targets and checks V2 readback, but no physical MAIN→MIX acceptance yet, and its behavior is not a proof that per-stage OVP/OCP cannot conflict.

**Public references:** Riden RD60xx UniSoft custom firmware reference (https://device.report/m/8a8fbfa06ae71aa02f3066894034f57ab11198f808da180b3f26fde2e9dc9800) explicitly states `OVP=0`, `OCP=0` disable corresponding software protections **for UniSoft custom firmware**. EEVblog user reports testing `OCP=0` on own RD6018 running UniSoft and the front panel blanks its OCP value: https://www.eevblog.com/forum/testgear/ruideng-riden-rd6006-dc-power-supply/1100/ . Official Riden manuals explain programming OVP/OCP via front panel but have not yet established the zero disable semantic for **node104 RD6018's exact device firmware**. Repo `esphome/rd6018.yaml` registers at Modbus holding 82 OVP, 83 OCP, both `min_value:0` on ESPHome numbers. This proves UI/firmware adapter accepts numeric zero at this layer, not that hardware disables reliably.

**Operational caution:** Simply relaxing the runtime guard to allow 0 would disable a protective layer on a live high-voltage Ca/Ca/EFB MIX charging system, and the existing SafetySupervisor START policy, runtime monitor, phase execution and readback expectations must be reviewed together. No command to write 0, START, flash or remotely edit node104 was executed. Confirm hardware firmware version and V2 semantics by read-only sources first. A guarded *offline* simulation of MAIN→MIX→safe-wait with explicit phase protection targets and verified readback is preferable to disabling both protections before a physical test. The existing current-setting CC regulation must never be presented as equivalent to separate protective OCP, and lease/thermal shutdown are independent safety controls.

**Decision pending physical test, not silently applied:** either retain positive phase-bounded OVP/OCP with correct transition sequencing (raise OVP before raising Vset; reduce I and settle before tightening OCP/OVP), or investigate firmware-specific zero disable solely in controlled hardware-off bench tests with a safe load and independent hardware limits. Do not remove safety gates or install zero semantics on node104 on documentation evidence alone. Source-only D151 commit 90cf2f8 remains local, uninstalled.

## 2026-11-09 — D153: OVP/OCP zero command admitted in guard only with confirmed OFF (source-only)

Owner instruction: "го разрешать 0", following documented investigation of the conflicting zero-rejection in `runtime/safety/runtime_guard.py`. Implemented minimal bounded acceptance in **existing** `RuntimeSafetyGuard.set_ovp/set_ocp` only (no second authority): `0.0` is an allowed value **only if Output OFF is positively observed** with fresh authoritative heartbeat (prefer `output_state_code_v2`, and require timestamp age ≤300 s). Hardware write on node104 NOT attempted. Tests cover OFF success, active ON failure, unknown/stale OFF, contradictory authoritative V2 ON, and negative values.

**Critical separation of behaviors:** D151 source-only `HassClient._retire_unrequested_protection_limits` still installs bounded **positive** protective OVP/OCP targets at START and confirms readback; it was **not** changed here to disable protections automatically. Stage transitions through MIX still require separate proof for OVP/OCP sequencing. Allowing zero with Output ON would disable independent protection during potential high-voltage battery charging and is deliberately not implemented. ### 2026-11-12 — MAIN continuous Imin stability; 72-hour existing fallback retained

Operator-approved rule: an accepted CV Imin is a historical minimum, not proof
of an uninterrupted hold. MAIN authority must use main_stable_hold_s, a single
analyzer-owned consecutive hold at the accepted minimum. A corroborated rise
(two consecutive valid samples above Imin + 0.005 A) invalidates the hold,
without erasing historical Imin. Upon return to minimum or acceptance of a lower
Imin the hold restarts at zero. A lone high reading is pending/no credited hold,
not a permanent reset. The 0.005 A band is an instrumentation threshold for
the 0.01 A reported resolution; it is not a battery-chemistry threshold.
Gaps >120 seconds or CC invalidate continuity; invalid samples never authorize
MAIN. The original seconds_since_current_min historical epoch and MIX CV
Delta-I / CC Delta-V behavior stay unchanged. MAIN HMI reads the new hold state
rather than deriving a false continuous countdown from historical Imin age.

The existing 72-hour MAIN fallback remains, with the existing intent-specific
actions (including Recovery MIX timeout handling) unmodified. No separate
high-voltage exposure timer or general charger recipe redesign before BW600.
Snapshots preserve historical Imin but conservatively restart MAIN stable hold
after restore/cooling when continuity cannot be proven. This change must not be
deployed by restarting an active charging service; acceptance requires safe
cutover with measurement / hardware verification.

Baseline replay from node104 EFB session 6b73479bdef74289b7b4ed3868069645:
from 2026-11-11 22:20:36 node104 local (accepted Imin=0.22 A) through
2026-11-12 ~00:41, 306 trace samples. Maximum continuous hold 252.235 s,

wall clock would have credited ~2.7 hours without sustained Imin. Replay is

## 2026-11-13 — AD048 upstream source follow-up (corrects source availability)
AD048's Codex run correctly stopped because exact pinned source snapshots were absent locally. After that run, read-only GitHub source fetches obtained exact ESPHome 2026.8.2 and aioesphomeapi v36.0.1/v46.2.0 files and materialized them under ignored `.recipe-studio-local/upstream-src/`; manifest and blob SHAs: `.recipe-studio-local/UPSTREAM_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_MANIFEST_20261113.md`. This supersedes the earlier "sources unavailable" blocker, but does NOT accept AD048 or authorize implementation.
Verified Modbus detail: `silent_retire()` sets pending=0 and device=null; unsent entries become RETIRED, while in-flight waiting entries retain WAITING state as reply-ignoring shells. `timed_out()` only calls on_no_response/retry when device != nullptr, so a silently retired in-flight frame cannot be requeued by its old owner. This is device-wide, not frame-specific. Address-scoped `retire()` is unsuitable because WAITING_RETIRED preserves the owner retry path. Safe use requires a dedicated Output ModbusClientDevice with exactly one active command and no telemetry/other actuator frames; a central owner must serialize all safety OFF and operator/API operations because clear will discard every queued frame for that device.
Current firmware has two R18 modbus_controller switches on the shared `powersupply` device (public `rd6018_output_public`, internal safety `rd6018_safety_output`); R18 telemetry probes also use `powersupply`. All must be separated: one dedicated writer device/owner, telemetry unchanged, no direct switch writer bypass.
Python compatibility: repo requirements supports 3.10 and pins aioesphomeapi 36.0.1 there. v36 execute_service is send-only, no return_response/call_id. v43 introduced async return_response and setup.py requires Python >=3.11; v46.2.0 supports it. Keep Python 3.10 support via app-level command-status/readback witness unless an explicit decision changes the supported matrix.
ESP8266 random_bytes maps to os_get_random; Wi-Fi/entropy readiness and setup priority ordering remain to be verified. No source edits/build/flash/deployment. Next task AD049: use saved exact source snapshots, complete queue/API/RNG + all-path owner design, and implement only if all gates are demonstrably safe. ## 2026-11-14 — AD051 hard boundary: RD6018 remains independently operable

User requirement: do not brick or strand the ESP8266, and do not make the RD6018 power supply dependent on an available ESPHome/HA controller for its own local operation. AD051 is a narrow software change to the ESP8266 bridge's R18 command owner only. It must not introduce a power interlock, mandatory Native API/HA handshake for RD6018 startup, boot-time dependency on Wi-Fi, forced RD6018 startup mode, or a requirement that ESPHome be online for the RD6018 front panel/native controls and native protection functions to work. If ESP8266/ESPHome/HA is unavailable, the RD6018 must remain independently operable through its own controls and firmware; ESPHome automation is unavailable, but the PSU itself must not be blocked.

Keep the distinction between this requirement and the EXISTING edge safety policy: while ESP8266 is alive and a managed session is active, its existing 900 s lease, 300 s renewal cadence, 20 s Modbus freshness rule and 5 s local OFF containment remain unchanged. Explicit persisted AUTONOMOUS mode retains its existing reboot/offline semantics; HANDS_OFF alone is not AUTONOMOUS. Do not silently weaken either policy to simulate standalone operation. No new Native API availability check may gate RD6018 hardware operation; no reconnect-triggered ON replay; no new boot nonce, NVS/flash writes, or persistent state for AD051.

Before any OTA: verify exact compiled image and target identity, ESP8266 1 MB layout/OTA image-size headroom, existing OTA/recovery route and rollback feasibility; preserve current known-good firmware/config backup. Do not flash while RD6018 Output is ON or while any battery recovery/high-voltage charge stage is active. Preflight must be fresh and direct Native evidence; HA cache is secondary. Do not attempt an OTA if ESP8266 recovery cannot be assured. A failed/unavailable Output Owner must not create a global Modbus queue stall or disable unrelated ESPHome telemetry; its failure must remain scoped to the Output entity/component. The RD6018 remains operable locally regardless.

No source change, OTA, flash, reboot, ESP command, setpoint or physical action was made by recording this boundary. Current AD051 compile acceptance is not firmware installation or physical acceptance.


## 2026-11-14 — User decision: start-source determines RD6018 ownership

The user explicitly selected two mutually exclusive operating paths. This decision supersedes any earlier suggestion that every locally started charge must be stopped after 900 seconds or that manual local start should be auto-adopted by the bot.

### A. Program-started charge = PB_MANAGED
- The program starts from a positively verified Output-OFF state, applies/reads back the authorized V/I/OVP/OCP values, arms the edge lease, and only then enables Output through the single R18 owner.
- The program owns the charging algorithm and actuator authority for the entire session: Output, setpoints and MAIN/MIX transitions. No second/local owner is inferred while this session is active.
- ESP8266 receives positive-ACK heartbeat renewal every 300 s. The local edge lease TTL remains exactly 900 s. If the program/HA-to-ESPHome control/heartbeat path disappears while the ESP8266 remains alive, lease expiry causes local Output OFF; no automatic ON after reconnect or reboot.
- Existing faster local containment remains: loss of fresh direct RD Modbus/control readback (>20 s) trips the managed lease; local OFF is retried every 5 s while the ESP8266 remains operational. Do not weaken this to wait 900 s.

### B. Locally started charge = HANDS_OFF + edge AUTONOMOUS
- The operator starts Output physically on the RD6018. The program remains a read-only observer: it may read telemetry, V/I/OVP/OCP, protection status and present warnings/diagnostics, but must not write Output, V/I, OVP/OCP, renew a managed lease, stop the charge due to bot/HA loss, or auto-adopt the session into PB_MANAGED.
- To preserve this local operation across ESPHome/API loss and ordinary ESP8266 reboot, the existing explicit edge `AUTONOMOUS` mode must be set while Output is confirmed OFF; bot ownership must already be HANDS_OFF. Only after that state is positively confirmed may the operator press Output on the RD6018. This is the existing safe entry contract in `rd6018_safety_lease.yaml`; HANDS_OFF alone is not enough.
- In this local mode the managed 900 s lease is unarmed and is not renewed. This is intentional: the user's physical start means the RD6018 owns the session. The program only watches.
- If Output is already ON but the ownership state is unknown, do not infer PB_MANAGED or silently set AUTONOMOUS. Remain non-actuating/read-only and report ownership as unknown until explicitly resolved.
- Intrinsic protections configured in the RD6018 remain active. Do not change them as part of AD051.

### Critical distinction / unresolved failure boundary
The 900 s lease is executed by the ESP8266; it is not an RD6018-native timer. The project currently documents Native RD6018 Timer Off as unused/unproven (`docs/assistant/COMM_LOSS_WATCHDOG_15MIN.md`, especially the section "Native RD6018 Timer Off must share the same authority heartbeat"). Therefore the 900 s guarantee covers loss of the program/heartbeat while the ESP8266 is still executing. It cannot be claimed to stop the RD6018 if the ESP8266 itself is physically dead, unpowered, or unable to issue Modbus. Do not claim that broader guarantee without separately proving the RD6018's own timer-off behavior. This limitation does not alter the user's decision that a locally started session is monitor-only and must not be stopped merely because the bot/HA disappears.

### AD051 scope boundary
AD051 remains only a single-owner R18 implementation change. It must preserve both paths above, all sensor/switch/config entities, OVP/OCP, R16 protection handling, MAIN/MIX, telemetry and the existing 900/300/20/5 timing contracts. No source/firmware change is authorized by this documentation update alone.

The HA102 add-on is confirmed running **ESPHome Device Builder 2026.10.0**, slug `5c53de3b_esphome`, ingress enabled. Its logs confirm compile job `f1ea89a72a59` for `rd6018.yaml` completed with exit code 0.

- `firmware/get_binaries` args: `{configuration: "rd6018.yaml"}`; read-only list of artifacts actually present on disk. Empty list means compile first.
- `firmware/download_token` args: `{configuration: "rd6018.yaml", file: <exact file from get_binaries>}`; returns a short-lived, single-use download token. Artifact bytes are then retrieved by HTTP `GET /api/firmware/download?token=...`, not as a WebSocket payload.
- `firmware/upload` args: `{configuration: "rd6018.yaml", port: "OTA"}`; uploads an existing compiled binary and does not recompile. `port="OTA"` asks ESPHome to resolve the configured `esphome.address`; do not invent or hardcode a device IP.
- `firmware/install` args: `{configuration: "rd6018.yaml", port: "OTA"}`; this is a compile + dependent upload chain. **Do not use it for this already-compiled job.** Device Builder 1.25.0 explicitly defers an OTA install when the device is offline and arms it to flash automatically on the next wake. - The ESPHome target is `esp8266: board: esp01_1m` with `ota: platform: esphome`. The exact OTA binary size/headroom has not yet been independently measured; compilation success alone does not prove it fits the 1 MB target's OTA slot.

### 2026-11-14 — Device Builder MCP limitation

ESPHome 2026.10.0 bundles Device Builder 1.25.0 (the 2026.10.0b6 release notes explicitly bump the bundled builder to 1.25.0: https://github.com/esphome/home-assistant-addon/releases). That version also exposes a built-in `POST /api/mcp` endpoint ([source](https://github.com/esphome/device-builder/blob/1.25.0/esphome_device_builder/api/mcp/__init__.py)), but its MCP tool registry exposes `compile` and `install`, not `firmware/get_binaries` or `firmware/upload`. It therefore cannot safely reuse the existing compile artifact without invoking the compile+upload `install` chain. Use the authenticated Device Builder WebSocket command path for `get_binaries` and `upload`; the non-browser ingress probe returned HTTP 401, and the add-on's direct 6052 port is not reachable from the HA host. No browser cookies or credentials were read.

### D061/D062 observer timing details — 2026-11-15 audit extension

## Additional source finding — cancellation is not automatically compensated

Independent current-source trace found a concrete gap separate from the stale HA REST premise:
- `runtime/safety/strict_guard.py:219-235` catches `Exception` around the ON call, not `asyncio.CancelledError`; cancellation bypasses its existing raw-state check/OFF containment.
- `application/execution_port.py:281-306` catches only `AttributeError/RuntimeError/TypeError/ValueError`; cancellation propagates through the port while the task-reentrant app lock unwinds.
- `application/start_transaction_service.py:431-447` catches `Exception` around `ExecutionPort.enable`; it does not issue `request_emergency_off` on task cancellation. Its helper `_confirm_failed_start_is_off` is reached only through the ordinary Exception path.
- `runtime/physical/transports/esp128.py:551-553` removes the Python receipt waiter/cache in `finally`; it does not cancel the already-sent firmware request or dispatch OFF.

Therefore same-owner queue serialization is useful **only after a new OFF request is actually issued**. The current START cancellation path does not itself issue that OFF. If cancellation is delivered after Native send and before receipt, the caller can unwind without waiting for the correlated receipt and without invoking the queue-fencing OFF. This remains an OPEN cancellation-containment gap regardless of whether the lower Modbus queue could safely serialize an explicit OFF. AD072 must retain this as a distinct finding. No implementation/test change.

AD051's same-owner queue fence closes host-side retransmission when a subsequent OFF is actually submitted: unsent ON is CANCELED; sent ON becomes OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN and its in-flight shell cannot callback/retry; replacement OFF waits behind the shell; APPLIED follows FC06 ACK plus one-shot FC03 R18 readback. This does not itself trigger OFF on task cancellation.

Concrete gap: StrictRuntimeSafetyGuard.turn_on catches Exception, not CancelledError; ExecutionPort.enable propagates cancellation; start_transaction_service compensates only in except Exception; ESPHomeTransport.command_output removes the waiter in finally without canceling the firmware command. Thus cancellation after Native send can unwind without issuing same-owner emergency OFF. Tests NOT RUN; existing source-contract tests do not cover canceled sent ON → same-owner OFF APPLIED end-to-end.

## 2026-11-15 — P1-AD088 accepted; AD089 conditional fence decision

AD088 full audit accepted. AD051 OutputOwner + retained exact ESPHome 2026.8.2 Modbus hub provides a conditional same-owner host-side late-retransmission fence: unsent ON retires CANCELED; sent ON becomes OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN and its in-flight WAITING shell is silently retired, so no device callback/retry can retransmit it. A subsequent OFF from the same owner waits for the outstanding response slot and must reach FC06 ACK + FC03 R18 readback matching OFF before OFF/APPLIED. This assumes one OutputOwner, one hub/device, one R18 writer, exact pinned queue implementation and serial request/response behavior. It does NOT prove ON never briefly applied, exclude another writer/restart/future write, or prove flashed firmware/physical behavior.

Critical current gap: START catches Exception but not asyncio.CancelledError. Cancellation clears the Python waiter/cache but does not settle an already delivered Native ON and does not automatically invoke same-owner OFF. Current connector/HassClient path loses the typed AD051 receipt as None/bool; generic guard bool may be based on heartbeat even when actuator result false. Existing VerifiedOffEvidence is not bound to the exact OFF request ID/APPLIED receipt. ha_esp alternative has no AD051 typed receipt; effective connector depends on RD6018_CONNECTOR override, not YAML default.

Decision recorded: docs/RD6018_AD089_SAME_OWNER_CANCELLATION_FENCE_DECISION_2026-11-15.md. Next contract must keep existing START service, ExecutionPort.request_emergency_off, ManagedRuntimeSafetyGuard/_off_lock and existing transport/connector chain; propagate exact typed receipt and pair it with a fresh direct Native R18=0 callback after terminal OFF; fail closed on ha_esp until equivalent receipt contract; shield one child settlement against repeated outer cancellation, then re-raise original cancellation; keep prior canonical session on failure. AD040/AD041/AD076 atomic session replacement/commit/readback remains separate blocking contract. No firmware queue redesign needed by source audit.

## 2026-11-16 — P1-AD127 Runtime Safety inheritance audit ACCEPTED — NO SAFE SLICE

Production bootstrap installs ManagedRuntimeSafetyGuard with patch_adapter=False, then creates/reuses the app-scoped ExecutionPort. ManagedRuntimeSafetyGuard -> StrictRuntimeSafetyGuard -> RuntimeSafetyGuard is one layered Safety owner, not parallel controllers. Runtime owns raw transport capture, telemetry/runtime envelope validation, readback and verified OFF under its private _off_lock. Strict adds EdgeSafetyLease arm/renew/disarm and independent lease-loss OFF containment. Managed adds managed-session, external-temperature integrity latch, foreign-output and telemetry grace policy.

Managed.turn_on delegates through Strict (edge lease) to Runtime (raw command/post-ON verification). Managed.get_all_live intentionally owns the managed read path and reuses base validation/lease primitives rather than calling Strict.get_all_live and duplicating its separate protection branch. The inherited OFF path keeps verified OFF and edge-lease disarm in the same owner chain.

ExecutionPort normal operations use GuardExecutionOwnerLock. Emergency OFF and its typed receipt path deliberately bypass that normal lock to preempt START/setter stalls, but still pass the ExecutionPort ownership gate and then serialize OFF under RuntimeSafetyGuard._off_lock. Lower Safety containment (edge lease loss, temperature/runtime faults) calls the same verified-OFF owner directly so fail-safe OFF never waits behind START. test_guard_execution_owner_lock explicitly proves this preemption behavior.

RdControlModeManager remains the sole durable PB_MANAGED/HANDS_OFF state owner. Its _write_mode() performs temp-file write, flush/fsync, atomic replace and best-effort directory fsync. Accepted schema is strict: version exactly 1, phase exactly release_requested, non-empty exact session_id. Invalid version/phase and mismatched session cannot authorize retirement.

Crash matrix:
- Before D060 durable commit: PB_MANAGED remains canonical. Startup sees PB + exact marker, clears only the marker, and preserves D061 restart OFF_PENDING for verified Output OFF recovery.
- After D060 durable commit: HANDS_OFF remains canonical. Startup sees HANDS_OFF + exact marker and retires D061 to INTERRUPTED without Output change. This reconciliation runs during install_hands_off_background_isolation() (bot.py line 231), before StartupRecovery construction and before startup reconciliation is run.
- AUTO stale restore authority is cleared during HANDS_OFF composition. Persisted Manual state restores as INTERRUPTED, never active/auto-resumed. D061 journal and release marker remain separate, single-owner state.

Concrete fixes:
1. D060 cancellation during lease prepare (pre-commit) restores PB, clears release_in_progress and resumes the suspended lease.
2. D060 cancellation during edge release (post-commit) never rolls back/resumes lease; it finishes Manual/AUTO software-only retirement, clears release_in_progress, then propagates cancellation. If cancellation interrupts Manual runner join, retirement is retried.
3. D061 wrapper handles CancelledError: before commit it clears only intent; after commit it retires exact D061 authority without Output change, then re-raises cancellation.
4. D060 rechecks D061 off_pending after the last awaited edge preflight and immediately before durable HANDS_OFF commit. No await separates the check and write, so a containment that wins pre-commit cannot be overwritten.
5. unmanaged-live HANDS_OFF recovery cancellation now restores PB/lease renewals before commit and preserves HANDS_OFF/suspended lease after commit.

D060/D061 intentional live release is explicitly not Output-OFF: it preserves current Output/V/I and uses the generation-bound EdgeSafetyLease prepare_hands_off_release()/release_to_hands_off() contract. D061 OFF_PENDING still uses the existing verified emergency-OFF path. No new physical OFF path or second disarm was introduced.

## 2026-11-16 — P1-AD137 HANDS_OFF -> PB_MANAGED verified-Output-OFF return audit ACCEPTED

The previous return_pb_control() read guard._raw_live() and accepted _binary(switch)==False. It bypassed the composed ExecutionPort/ManagedRuntimeSafetyGuard read boundary and ignored canonical V2 output_state_code_v2 and its source heartbeat. A stale legacy switch OFF could disagree with canonical Output and still be used as the PB ownership-return proof.

The existing manager method now:
1. Retains its stale managed-session authority check.
2. Reads through the app-scoped ExecutionPort.read_live().
3. Resolves Output using the Safety owner's canonical _output_evidence(); V2 register-18 takes precedence over legacy switch.
4. Validates freshness against the exact evidence source. If V2 is present, its own output_state_code_v2 heartbeat is mandatory; a fresh switch alias cannot rescue stale V2. If V2 is absent, the existing legacy switch compatibility path remains under the shared telemetry freshness policy.
5. If EdgeSafetyLease is enforced, suspends renewals and requires the same lease to be healthy/unarmed: no trip, no boot quarantine, fresh Modbus and remaining time within ACK slack. If still armed/outside the unarmed ACK envelope, the existing disarm() and readback are used. An already healthy/unarmed lease is not disarmed twice. Missing/unhealthy lease blocks PB return.
6. Only after both proofs succeed clears OFF containment, retires stale AUTO restore authority, writes PB_MANAGED through the existing manager writer and updates the in-memory mode.

HANDS_OFF renewals remain suspended. A later explicit START arms the same app.edge_safety_lease; no second lease or heartbeat owner was introduced.

Production wrapper order is unchanged: RdAutonomousModeCoordinator blocks active/pending/uncertain AUTONOMOUS before the underlying return; RdStartupAuthorityGate wraps afterwards and marks managed recovery complete only after success. Existing HMI/stale HANDS_OFF callbacks and physical-test diagnostic call the same manager method and traverse the same wrappers.

Added nine fake-only regressions: stale switch heartbeat; canonical V2 ON vs legacy OFF; missing V2 heartbeat; stale V2 vs fresh alias; fresh V2 vs stale alias; armed lease disarm; no duplicate disarm; missing required lease; tripped/unhealthy lease.

## 2026-11-16 — P1-AD138 EdgeSafetyLease post-return lifecycle and renewal-authority audit ACCEPTED

Production ManagedRuntimeSafetyGuard inherits the single StrictRuntimeSafetyGuard lease owner. The explicit app.edge_safety_lease and deferred ensure_edge_safety_lease() creation branches are mutually exclusive; once present, the exact same object is reused by app, guard, ExecutionPort owner, EdgeAutonomousAuthority and EdgeLiveAdoption. Production constructor callsites are confined to runtime/safety/strict_guard.py; the transient acceptance harness has its own isolated lease.

The only production initial ARM callsite is StrictRuntimeSafetyGuard._arm_edge_lease(), invoked by StrictRuntimeSafetyGuard.turn_on() before parent Output ON. The only production renew_if_due() callsite is the guard live-read renewal path; ManagedRuntimeSafetyGuard invokes it only when Output is ON and a managed controller is active. Output-OFF returns before renewal. D061 EdgeLiveAdoption may resume renewals on the same lease only after its positive edge-adoption ACK; D060/unmanaged-live rollback may resume the same lease to restore the prior PB owner. Neither constructs a lease or performs initial ARM.

Fixed a STOP/ownership revocation race: arm() could wait on _operation_lock and then clear _renewals_suspended after another owner had already issued STOP/HANDS_OFF. Added a monotonic _renewal_epoch to the existing EdgeSafetyLease. suspend_renewals() and resume_renewals() advance the epoch; queued ARM/renew requests capture it before lock acquisition; requests recheck before and after edge command/readback. A newer STOP/transfer revokes queued and in-flight operations, even if ESP applied the command before ACK. Stale failed requests do not overwrite newer suspend/resume decisions.

Failed/cancelled ARM now suspends renewals unless a newer owner revocation already controls the state. If ESP applied ARM but ACK was cancelled/lost, the existing 900-second lease is left to expire and background polls cannot renew it. A later explicit START may retry ARM through the same owner.

renew_if_due() now refuses an unarmed lease; only explicit arm(force=True) can establish one. Background renewal cannot create a new lease. ManagedRuntimeSafetyGuard regression proves one app-scoped object, one ARM before Output ON, renewal only while managed Output is ON, verified OFF disarms, and subsequent Output-OFF polling does not renew/re-arm.

Added seven fake-only regressions: cancelled ARM after ESP apply; failed ARM; queued ARM revoked by STOP; in-flight ARM revoked by STOP; suspended poll preserving the current epoch; background renewal unable to establish an unarmed lease; same-object ManagedRuntimeSafetyGuard ARM/renew/OFF lifecycle.

## 2026-11-16 — P1-AD136 D060/D061 HANDS_OFF release transaction and crash-recovery audit ACCEPTED

D060 active-session release is owned by _release_active_transaction() in rd_hands_off_release.py. Its UI confirmation is exact-session-bound and single-use. The transaction holds the manager transition lock, revalidates the active token, preflights the edge lease, checks D061 OFF_PENDING immediately before commit, and commits durable HANDS_OFF through the existing manager._write_mode(). D061 release intent is a version-1 release_requested marker bound to the exact D061 session. Adoption state remains owned by the existing adoption coordinator/journal. Unmanaged live-output recovery is a distinct path: fresh confirmed Output ON and edge evidence are required; active managed sessions are rejected; the same manager writer commits HANDS_OFF before any edge release command; Output/V/I are never written.

The canonical manager writer uses a same-directory temporary file, flush+fsync, atomic os.replace and best-effort directory fsync. D060 ordering is: lock and exact-token validation; suspend renewals/preflight; recheck D061 OFF_PENDING after the final await; durable HANDS_OFF commit; edge release; software-only Manual/AUTO retirement; finally clear release_in_progress. Precommit cancellation/failure preserves PB and resumes the existing lease; postcommit cancellation never rolls back or resumes the lease and completes software retirement. Existing D060 pre/postcommit cancellation tests remain passing.

Crash matrix: before commit, PB remains authoritative and a matching marker is cleared on PB startup while D061 restart containment remains; after HANDS_OFF commit but before D061 retirement, startup requires HANDS_OFF plus exact session marker to retire D061 without Output OFF; wrong version/phase/session cannot retire; marker-clear failure is safe to retry because exact-session retirement is idempotent.

AD136 fixed a concrete atomicity defect in _retire_adopted_authority(): it previously detached coordinator._task and changed memory to INTERRUPTED before persisting the terminal journal. A failed write could lose the monitor reference and leave memory terminal while durable state remained ACTIVE. It now snapshots prior state/status, persists while retaining the task reference, restores prior in-memory state/status on failure, and only after durable success detaches/cancels the monitor. Added failure-injection regression proves ACTIVE state/status and task reference survive failed persistence.

Added D061 precommit and postcommit cancellation tests. Precommit cancellation retains PB and ACTIVE D061 and clears only the marker. Postcommit cancellation preserves HANDS_OFF, retires exact D061 authority, issues no verified Output OFF and clears the marker.

## 2026-11-16 — P1-AD139 START cancellation from EdgeSafetyLease ARM through Output ON and START_PENDING settlement ACCEPTED

Production START remains application.start_transaction_service.start_profile_transactional(). Its existing _serialized_charge_start requires the canonical app-scoped ExecutionPort GuardExecutionOwnerLock and holds it across START preflight, START_PENDING, controller preparation, physical enable and final commit. START persists and exact-readback-verifies START_PENDING before controller/session mutation and physical enable. enable_submitted=True is set immediately before await port.enable(), so cancellation anywhere inside the enable boundary (including lease ARM) enters the conservative single OFF settlement. ManagedRuntimeSafetyGuard/StrictRuntimeSafetyGuard performs _arm_edge_lease() before its parent Output ON path; cancellation during ARM never reaches super().turn_on(). EdgeSafetyLease cancellation leaves renewals suspended.

settle_submitted_enable() is created once and retained. Cancellation repeatedly awaits that exact task through asyncio.shield(); repeated cancellation cannot create another OFF. Settlement requires an exact typed APPLIED/OFF receipt (register 18=0, valid connection generation), then a fresh Native OFF report strictly after receipt completion and from the same generation. Only then does it stop the live controller without clearing session, verify the exact START_PENDING bytes/envelope remain, and rollback to the embedded prior bytes with readback. Missing evidence, changed pending, committed candidate or uncertain rollback quarantines instead of inventing rollback. The existing Safety owner disarms the same app lease after verified OFF.

### 1. Цель и целевая структура

Главная цель — полная декомпозиция RD6018 и модульная архитектура без изменения принятого поведения, без второго параллельного двигателя и без усложнения ради архитектуры. | № | Функциональный отдел | Основная зона ответственности |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Battery / Chemistry | Химия, профили, ограничения, чистые доменные решения |
| 2 | Charge Engine | MAIN, MIX, AGM, EFB, desulfation, Imin, stage transitions |
| 3 | Application | START, STOP, SET, COOLING, MIX, RECOVERY use cases |
| 4 | Safety Authority | Safety decisions, admission, lease, trips, OFF policy |
| 5 | Physical Execution | Единственный существующий ExecutionPort и физические адаптеры |
| 6 | Telemetry / Evidence | Измерения, freshness, provenance, normalized evidence |
| 7 | Sessions / Persistence | AUTO, Manual, operator state, atomic persistence |
| 8 | Recovery / Ownership | Startup, restore, adoption, HANDS_OFF / PB_MANAGED |
| 9 | UI | Telegram, Dashboard, HMI, Recipe Studio, presentation |
| 10 | Integrations | HA, ESP Native, Wake, AI/context, notifications |
| 11 | Composition / Deploy | Composition root, configuration, install/update/rollback/DR |

Для каждого отдела обязательны: один утверждённый функциональный owner; один владелец каждого состояния и решения; явные интерфейсы/DTO/ports; карта входов, выходов, consumers и side effects; независимые тесты; OWNERSHIP.md; проверяемая композиция. No BW600 implementation, physical action, or autonomous CDC workflow is authorized before that point.
